pr_body: Decode supported HTTP body types and return an HTTP status with the parsed JSON payload.
author: developer

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+def handle_request(request: dict[str, object]):
+    """Decode a request body into an HTTP status and JSON payload."""
+    import json
+
+    body = request.get("body")
+    if not isinstance(body, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
+        return 400, None
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(body)
+    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+        return 400, None
+    return 200, payload
